title: CollaborationInteraction
description: One consult or review interaction. A review interaction is pinned to a work generation and a trigger event; a consult interaction has neither. result is null while the interaction is open.

schema_version.description: Frozen data-contract version. A change of shape requires a new directory, never an in-place edit.

activation_kind.description: Trusted entry point that started the interaction.

host_instance.description: Stable identifier of the host instance that owned the interaction.

input_refs.description: Inputs newly supplied by this interaction. A review may legitimately add none.

trigger_ref.description: Review trigger event; null for consult.

work_id.description: Reviewed pending work; null for consult.

work_generation.description: Work generation reviewed by this interaction; null for consult.

result.description: null while open; otherwise the frozen terminal result. candidate_pending is a terminal result of the interaction, not of the candidate.

receipt_request_id.description: request_id of the processed_commands receipt produced by a WAIT or commit; null when no such receipt exists.

access_ref.description: Opaque reference to the access authorization used to read the interaction's inputs.

policy_ref.description: Opaque reference to the policy decision that allowed the interaction.
